title: Cameras software versions MV 7.2.2 changelog

announcements.post_subject: A new Recommended Release MV Cameras firmware is now available

Bug fixes: Resolved an issue with Rapid Review and Privacy Windows on second generation cameras.
Resolved a condition where second generation cameras could enter a boot loop.
Notice: When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15
MV7.2 is the last supported firmware branch for MV12, MV2, MV22, MV32, MV52 and MV72 series. Future updates for these models will be limited to maintenance and security patches

html:
Cameras software versions MV 7.2.2 changelog

Bug fixes

  • Resolved an issue with Rapid Review and Privacy Windows on second generation cameras.

  • Resolved a condition where second generation cameras could enter a boot loop.

Notice

  • When configured for this version, MV21 & MV71 cameras will run MV4.15

  • MV7.2 is the last supported firmware branch for MV12, MV2, MV22, MV32, MV52 and MV72 series. Future updates for these models will be limited to maintenance and security patches
